thread:
Sarah - Support: FYI we've got a high-severity report from ZenLedger on their Private deployment — p95 latency for chat endpoints jumped from ~220ms to ~1.8s since last deploy. They're seeing timeouts on heavy batch jobs.
Mia P: Oof. Any recent config changes for Private or dedicated routing?
Sam R: Not in infra — we rolled a small runtime patch 3am UTC that touched batching heuristics.
Jordan (oncall): I'm digging into metrics now. Can someone paste the customer's exact timestamps and a repro curl?
Sarah - Support: Customer provided logs and a curl, pasted below. They said it started at 2026-03-19T02:10:00Z. Repro:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -X POST https://private.redwood.example/v1/chat \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-13b", "messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize Q1 invoice batches"}], "max_tokens":512, "batch_size":8}'
```
They see spikes at the start of batch runs.
Mia P: Batch size 8 on Private — we changed continuous batching threshold in the patch to prefer larger batches for throughput. Possible regression on small prompt paths.
Sam R: Jordan, I pushed a quick dashboard: kv cache hit rate, batch sizes, and queue depth for ZenLedger tenant id. Link: https://grafana/redwood/d/xyz
Jordan (oncall): Looking — around the incident window queue depth for rwd-llama-13b jumps to 6-8, p95 for token generation goes up and CPU on the host is fine but GPU utilization drops.
Mia P: GPU drop + queue build suggests either a blocking sync on CPU side or a kernel fallback causing long cold-start. Any recent quantization/kernel changes in that patch?
Sam R: The runtime patch did introduce a new kernel selection shim that can fall back to a slower path if it can't find a vectorized kernel for certain sequence lengths. Could be mis-detecting sequence length and taking slow path.
Jordan (oncall): I pulled full logs: several lines like `kernel_selector: fallback to scalar_kernel for seq_len=256, model=rwd-llama-13b` at 02:12:07. That aligns with the p95 spike.
Sarah - Support: Customer wants a timeline and workaround. They're on a paid Dedicated contract with 99.9% p95 SLA. Len (PM), we need to decide if this is a hotfix vs. migration to hosted.
Len (PM): This sounds like a regression; treat as P0 for Dedicated customers. Need mitigation fast + a roadmap ticket to prevent recurrence. Assigning RD-3421 to eng-runtime for hotfix.
Mia P: Immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback kernel selector change (fast but invasive), 2) force fallback to previous kernel mapping via tenant config (safer), 3) route ZenLedger to an alternate model variant while we fix. Thoughts?
Sam R: We can push a tenant override to force old mapping. I'll prepare the config patch.
Jordan (oncall): Temporary routing to hosted or a quantized variant will affect fidelity; customer flagged accuracy as important. Prefer tenant override if it restores perf without model change.
Sarah - Support: ZenLedger prefers no model change. They'll accept a short maintenance window to apply fixes if performance is restored.
Mia P: OK Sam, prioritize tenant-config override. Jordan, watch metrics. If p95 doesn't recover in 15m, plan rollback.
Sam R: Pushing override now to ZenLedger tenant id...
infra-bot: deploy started for tenant override (deploy-id: dpl-8891)
deploy-bot: canary complete, routing update applied to tenant: zenledger-001
Jordan (oncall): Metrics showing immediate improvement — p95 back to ~240ms within 5m and queue depth normalizing.
Sarah - Support: Customer confirms improved response times on their side. They want postmortem and a longer-term fix on the roadmap.
Len (PM): I'll add an initiative to the product roadmap: "Kernel selection stability and tenant-safe fallback policies". Scope: automatic detection of scalar fallbacks, telemetry alerting + safer default policy. Target milestone Q2 dev cycle.
Mia P: Also add automated canary tests for sequence-length edge cases and a unit test to catch kernel-selector regressions.
Sam R: I'll open a PR to revert the heuristic change and add a feature flag instead. Link: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/572 (draft).
Jordan (oncall): Ticket RD-3421 updated with timeline and RCA notes. Assigning owners: Sam (hotfix), Mia (tests), Len (PM/roadmap).
Sarah - Support: I'll send the customer the interim report and ETA for permanent fix. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Mia P: Good catch everyone. Follow-ups: 1) finish hotfix + revert or flag, 2) roadmap ticket with acceptance criteria (alerting, tests), 3) customer comms ready by EOD.
Sam R: Will update PR and post status in this thread.
Jordan (oncall): Leaving monitoring on — ping me if anything regresses. :eyes:
infra-bot: incident RD-3421 marked as mitigated at 1777501474
